trailhead.label: Clelles-Mens railway station, the board’s start

cautions: The departmental road is crossed twice: keep your dog close.
Stretches of open farmland between the woods, with little shade there on hot days.
Livestock may be in the fields beside the track.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
